reason: The completed first phase improves Aegis discrimination but fails validation with one common score threshold. No test inference occurs in that phase.
goal: Exceed 0.84 complete-stream operational accuracy on the unchanged exposed 60-episode regression; separately evaluate first-use Aegis test data.

fixed_base_models.mixed: First-phase tfidf_mixed_75_25, selected by the higher first-phase development objective, not test results
fixed_base_models.canary: Original frozen canary; not an input to the guardrail ensemble

input: Text only. Each guardrail evaluation executes both base guardrails and a calibration head. The head receives only their clipped logits, with scores clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6]. No model-output cache, source IDs, labels, domain IDs, or fault metadata enter inference.

development_roles.aegis: Split the existing development validation groups in half within group-label strata. Sort by SHA256([42,stack-role-v1,group_id]); first floor(n/2) groups fit heads, remainder select thresholds.
development_roles.synthetic_role_scope: Disjoint matched cases and rows, but the calibration roles share ten intent families; no claim of independent family-level validation.
development_roles.test: Neither original test nor prepared Aegis test enters calibration or candidate selection.

head_sample_weights: Equal source shares and class shares; equal group weight within each source/class.

selection.ties: Objectives rounded to 12 decimals, then higher mean recall, then earlier fixed head. Threshold ties prefer higher threshold.

runtime: Unchanged scenario rules, seeds, streams, fault timing, probes, cadence, response delay, verification tolerance, approvals, containment, and complete-stream denominators. Guardrail counts refer to composite evaluations, not primitive classifier calls.
execution: Native s390x LinuxONE, pinned environment, one thread, exact committed source. Preserve all first-phase artifacts and both heads. Evaluate only the validation-selected head.
promotion: Do not mutate the published release. Report both successful and unsuccessful results.
